narrative.summary: An EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy whose mint and upgrade rights are wards: the Sky governance pause proxy and the UsdsJoin adapter. Nobody else holds one.
narrative.detail: Added 2026-10-11. Scored with the Sky pause target's own values (75 / 100 / 70, composite 81). The ward set is replayed from the token's Rely and Deny history on every pass and must be exactly those two; a third ward degrades the score. Shares its root with the Sky pause, SparkLend and DAI.
